title: Expressing Advantage and Redistribution with javára ('in favor of / to the benefit of')

sections.title: Structural Meaning as the Antonym of rovására
sections.content: Javára (from java = 'its best part') marks the party that gains, benefits, or receives transferred assets or advantages in a historical, legal, or social process. The preceding noun is nominative or possessive: a nincstelenek javára ('in favor of the landless'), az állam javára ('to the benefit of the state').

sections.title: Institutional Shifts and Redistribution
sections.content: In historical and socioeconomic analysis, javára describes shifting power balances: 'A mérleg a szövetkezetek javára billent' ('The balance tipped in favor of the cooperatives'). It pairs naturally with rovására in parallel structures: 'A nagybirtokok rovására, a parasztok javára osztottak földet.'

sections.title: Collocations with javára in Historical Prose
rows: A nagybirtokokat a zsellérek javára sajátították ki.
Large estates were expropriated in favor of landless cottagers.
A döntés a termelőszövetkezetek javára kedvezett.
The decision favored the agricultural cooperatives.
Lemondott a birtokról a fia javára.
He relinquished the estate in favor of his son.
A gazdasági mérleg a városok javára tolódott el.
The economic balance shifted in favor of the cities.

items.spanish: 1945-ben a nagybirtokrendszert felszámolták a nincstelen parasztság javára.
items.english: In 1945, the latifundia system was abolished in favor of the landless peasantry.

items.spanish: A hatalom az egyéni gazdák rovására, a kolhoz típusú gazdaságok javára csoportosította át a gépeket.
items.english: The regime redistributed machinery at the expense of individual farmers, in favor of kolkhoz-type farms.

items.spanish: A reformok végül a hatékonyabb termelés javára billentették a mérleget.
items.english: The reforms ultimately tipped the scale in favor of more efficient production.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Use javára to mark the beneficiary, and rovására to mark the party bearing the costs!
